```{r}
overlapSums <- function(x, y, z, na.rm=FALSE) {
  stopifnot(class(x)=="GRanges")
  stopifnot(class(y)=="GRanges")
  stopifnot(class(z)=="numeric" | class(z)=="integer")
  stopifnot(length(x)==length(z))
  ov <- as.matrix(findOverlaps(y, x))
  ovSums <- rep(as.numeric(NA), length(y))
  ovSums[unique(ov[,1])] <- viewSums(Views(z[ov[,2]], ranges(Rle(ov[,1]))), na.rm=na.rm)
  ovSums
}


overlapRatios <- function(x, y, C, cov, minCov, na.rm=FALSE) {
  C.sum <- overlapSums(x, y, values(x)[[C]], na.rm=na.rm)
  cov.sum <- overlapSums(x, y, values(x)[[cov]], na.rm=na.rm)
  ov_all <- as.data.frame(findOverlaps(y, x)) 
  number_of_CpGs <- rle(ov_all[,1])$lengths #--- total number of CpGs per region
  CpG_ov_regions <- x[ov_all$subjectHits] #--- coverage of CpGs overlapping regions
  ov_all$cov <- as.numeric(values(CpG_ov_regions)[[cov]])
  ov_all$cov_binary<-as.numeric(ifelse(ov_all$cov>=minCov, 1, 0))
  number_of_CpGs_minCov <- as.numeric(tapply(ov_all$cov_binary, ov_all$queryHits, FUN=sum))
  CpGs_covered <- as.numeric(number_of_CpGs_minCov) / as.numeric(number_of_CpGs)
  rat <- as.data.frame(C.sum/cov.sum)
  rat_cov<-cbind(rat, CpGs_covered)
  colnames(rat_cov) <- c("rat", "CpGs_covered")
  rat_cov$rat[rat_cov$CpGs_covered < 0.5] <- NA
  rat_cov[,1]
}
```

#background CpGs
```{r}
# Define chromosomes to keep
keep_chrs <- paste0("chr", c(1:6, "X", "Y"))

# Filter CpG object
CpG_sc <- CpG[seqnames(CpG) %in% keep_chrs]

#select rows with median coverage >=3
# Get coverage column names
cov_cols <- grep("\\.cov$", colnames(mcols(CpG_sc)), value = TRUE)

# Calculate median coverage for each row
median_cov <- apply(mcols(CpG_sc)[, cov_cols], 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)

# Add median coverage as metadata column
mcols(CpG_sc)$median_cov <- median_cov

# Filter for median coverage >= 3
CpG_filt <- CpG_sc[CpG_sc$median_cov >= 3]

```

```{r}
dss <- CpG_filt

dss<-GRangesList(dss)
dss_ext <- lapply(dss, function(x) promoters(x, upstream = 500, downstream = 500))
#dss_ext<-GRangesList(dss_ext)

dmrs_raw <- GRangesList()
for(i in 1:length(dss_ext)){
  dmrs_raw[[i]] <- reduce(dss_ext[[i]]) 
}
names(dmrs_raw) <- names(dss_ext)
names(dmrs_raw) <- "background"

width <- lapply(dmrs_raw, function(x) x$width <- width(x))
for(i in 1:length(dmrs_raw)){
  dmrs_raw[[i]]$length <- width[[i]]
}


#dss <- GRangesList(dss)
dss_un <- unlist(dss)
cpg_count <- lapply(dmrs_raw, function(x) countOverlaps(x, dss_un))

cpg_count <- list()
for(i in 1:length(dmrs_raw)){
  cpg_count[[i]] <- countOverlaps(dmrs_raw[[i]], dss[[i]])
}


cpg_count_total <- lapply(dmrs_raw, function(x) countOverlaps(x, CpG))
for(i in 1:length(dmrs_raw)){
  dmrs_raw[[i]]$cpg_count <- cpg_count[[i]]
  dmrs_raw[[i]]$cpg_count_total <- cpg_count_total[[i]]
  dmrs_raw[[i]]$cpg_per_sign <- dmrs_raw[[i]]$cpg_count / dmrs_raw[[i]]$cpg_count_total
}

dmrs <- GRangesList()
for(i in 1:length(dmrs_raw)){
  dmrs[[i]] <- dmrs_raw[[i]][mcols(dmrs_raw[[i]])$length >= 1000 & mcols(dmrs_raw[[i]])$cpg_count >= 3 & mcols(dmrs_raw[[i]])$cpg_per_sign >= 0.01]
}
names(dmrs) <- names(dmrs_raw)
lapply(dmrs, length)

for(i in 1:length(dmrs)){
  dmrs[[i]] <- resize(dmrs[[i]], width(dmrs[[i]]) - 500, fix="end")
  dmrs[[i]] <- resize(dmrs[[i]], width(dmrs[[i]]) - 498, fix="start")
}
lapply(dmrs, length)


x <- dmrs[[1]]
export(x, "/Users/ksenia/Documents/Lab_Garvan/projects/marsupials/invariant/final_T2T_genome/invariant_regions_BACKGROUND_ext500_l1000_cpg3.bed")
```

###--- identify invariant CpGs
```{r}
###---Calc methylation score per CpG
col<-seq(1, ncol(mcols(CpG)), by=2)
names <- sub('\\..*', '', colnames(mcols(CpG))[col])
col <- setNames(col, names)

mc_score <- mapply(function(a, b){as.numeric(mcols(CpG)[, a]) / as.numeric(mcols(CpG)[, b])}, a = col, b = col+1) # calculates methylation ratio using .C and .cov of adjacent columns 
mc_score<-as.data.frame(mc_score)

z <- mc_score
mcols(CpG) <- z

###---Select rows with >=0.7 and <=1.0 mCG/CG
sample_cols <- colnames(mcols(CpG))
mcols_df <- as.data.frame(mcols(CpG))
in_range <- mcols_df[, sample_cols] >= 0.7 & mcols_df[, sample_cols] <= 1.0
all_in_range <- apply(in_range, 1, all, na.rm = TRUE)
CpG_invariant_hi <- CpG[all_in_range]

head(CpG_invariant_hi)

###---Select rows with median cov >=3
CpG_invariant_hi_cov3 <- subsetByOverlaps(CpG_invariant_hi, CpG_filt)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(viridis)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)


x.na$region_id <- paste0("Region_", 1:nrow(x.na))

sample_order <- c("sperm_r1", "sperm_r2", "E9epi_r1", "E9te_r1")

meth_matrix <- as.matrix(x.na[, sample_order])
rownames(meth_matrix) <- x.na$region_id

row_variance <- apply(meth_matrix, 1, var)
low_var_threshold <- quantile(row_variance, 0.5)  # Split by median variance

row_annotation <- data.frame(
  Variance_Level = ifelse(row_variance < low_var_threshold, "Very Low", "Low"),
  E9te_Drop = x.na$E9epi_r1 - x.na$E9te_r1  # Show E9te methylation drop
)
rownames(row_annotation) <- x.na$region_id

ann_colors <- list(
  Variance_Level = c("Very Low" = "darkred", "Low" = "#F39B7F"),
  E9te_Drop = colorRampPalette(c("white", "orange", "red"))(100)
)

# Create heatmap
setwd("/Users/ksenia/Documents/Lab_Garvan/projects/marsupials/invariant/final_T2T_genome/gene_bodies/")
pdf("invariant_regions_heatmap.pdf", width = 7, height = 5)
pheatmap(meth_matrix,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100),
         cluster_cols = FALSE,  # Keep our sample order
         clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
         annotation_row = row_annotation,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         main = "Invariant Regions - Methylation Patterns",
         border_color = NA,
         fontsize = 10,
         breaks = seq(0, 1, length.out = 101))
dev.off()
```
